title: Signature Opaque cursor tokens — Cursor-Based Retrieval Manager
description: Signature original — Cursors are opaque to clients: base64 blobs encoding position, never raw offsets. Opacity lets servers change the encoding without breaking clients. Clients treat cursors as bookmarks. This record documents a Signature-authored original method of the JAH archive toolkit, clearly labeled as Signature work rather than a public record.
demo:
# Cursor pagination: opaque base64 cursors encode (last_id); each fetch continues.
import base64, json
records = [{"id": i, "v": "rec-%02d" % i} for i in range(1, 12 + 1)]
def encode(last_id): return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps({"last": last_id}).encode()).decode()
def decode(cur): return json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(cur.encode()))["last"] if cur else 0
def fetch(cursor, n):
    last = decode(cursor)
    batch = [r for r in records if r["id"] > last][:n]
    nxt = encode(batch[-1]["id"]) if len(batch) == n and batch[-1]["id"] < records[-1]["id"] else None
    return batch, nxt
cur, n = None, 5
for step in range(3):
    batch, cur = fetch(cur, n)
    print(f"batch: {[r['v'] for r in batch]} -> next cursor: {cur[:12] + '...' if cur else None}")
    if not cur: break
provenance: Signature-authored original method created for the JAH archive toolkit; clearly labeled Signature, not a public record.
